highlights.title: Russian drone ‘aimed directly’ at Ukraine security service HQ, Zelensky says
highlights.summary: A Russian drone struck the headquarters of Ukraine's SBU security services in Kyiv on Friday afternoon, said Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, injuring five people. The attack followed a series of deadly overnight strikes across Ukraine, including the southern Odesa region.
